entities.summary: Keifer Jerail Sykes is an American professional basketball player for Hubei Wenlv of the National Basketball League (NBL). He played college basketball for the University of Wisconsin–Green Bay. Sykes is featured in the 2018 documentary film Chi-Town, produced and directed by Nick Budabin, following his path from high school to his brush with the NBA.
